messages:
Ben M.: quick heads-up — we're scheduled to ramp feature flag `ff_dynamic_routing` from 0% -> 5% at 01:30 UTC in the late-night window. plan attached in the doc link.
Alice R.: copy. which cohort are we using for the 5%? small EU-only bucket?
Ben M.: yes, EU-only cohort A (cookie_hash mod 200 < 10). keep routing pinned to model-routing:v2 for that cohort.
Chloe S.: reminder: pinning model version for the cohort is important — if v2 shows regression we want instant fallback to v1 without global impact.
Dan K.: ops checklist: autoscaler set to min=4, burst cap enabled, qps limit 120/s per pod. tracing enabled.
deploy-bot: Deploy window open at 01:25 UTC. Running preflight checks: infra=OK, quota=OK, canary=skipped (we use FF cohorts).
Alice R.: one ask — can we delay to 01:40 if any db maintenance overlap? I see a scheduled vacuum at 01:20 in eu-west.
Ben M.: good catch. I'll coordinate. if vacuum is still active at 01:30 we hold and run at 01:40. let's not risk tail latency.
Eva L.: if we hold, update release notes and push a quick announcement to #general. don't want SRE paged blind.
Ben M.: agreed. leaving final GO/NO-GO at 01:35 UTC. @deploy-bot please queue the toggle for 01:40 as backup.
deploy-bot: queued: toggle `ff_dynamic_routing` -> 5% at 4781240000 (01:40 UTC). preflight will re-run at t-5m.
Chloe S.: t-10m health probe: can someone run a short latency sweep on routing pods? `heybench --target model-routing:v2 --rps 50 --dur 60s`
Dan K.: running now, attaching quick results: median=32ms, p95=120ms, error=0.4% (mostly 429s during pod warmup).
Alice R.: 429s are expected transiently. if p95 > 250ms we abort. current looks fine.
Ben M.: GO for 01:40 then. will monitor token-level cost and latency dashboards.
deploy-bot: executing toggle now.
Ben M.: toggled to 5%.
Eva L.: seeing initial spike in p99 on shard-3, about 800ms, small sample.
Chloe S.: can we roll back the cohort pin to v1 for shard-3 only? we have per-shard pinning capability right?
Ben M.: yes — we can patch routing policy: shard-3 -> model-routing:v1, keep others on v2. applying now.
Dan K.: applied patch. shard-3 p99 back to 120ms within 90s.
Ben M.: good mitigation. leave FF at 5% to observe.
Alice R.: note for release notes: toggled ff_dynamic_routing to 5% EU cohort, shard-specific fallback applied due to transient p99. follow-up action: run load-profile test replay and consider canary-run for v2 with reduced seq lengths.
deploy-bot: recorded action: toggle, patch, stabilization. creating release note draft: https://go/release/4781239876
Ben M.: closing loop: keep this window open for 2 hours. if no regressions, we'll ramp to 25% at 04:00 UTC. assigning postmortem to eng-runtime if further anomalies.
Eva L.: added to calendar and notified support rotation. :thumbsup:
Chloe S.: filing a tiny eval to compare model outputs v1 vs v2 on 500 prompts (quality-sanity).
Ben M.: thanks team. I'll update the changelog and mark the deploy as partial-rollout in the release doc.
